metadata.actual_peak_definition: max over both time halves of |I-iQ| after DRAG
metadata.grid: 5 to 60 MHz, 0.5 MHz steps; -0.5 to +0.5 MHz detuning, 2.5 kHz steps
metadata.duration_only: Set duration_us=30; retain core, tail, taper-width and phase scales. Move endpoints outward.
metadata.full_stretch: Raw u(t) becomes u(t/s), s=30/L. Every envelope, phase, transition and taper time stretches. DRAG derivative is divided by s before peak normalization.
metadata.optimization: None. Frozen coefficients and beta; duration changes only.
metadata.comparison_scope: Exact signs on sampled maps, not a continuous interval proof; spectral guardrails are not new optimization constraints.
